item.title: Notes on San Marino
item.description:
📝 It took two trains over five hours for me to get from Rome to Rimini, from which almost everyone enters San Marino. Like every other European Microstate (except Andorra), there are no border checkpoints around San Marino. I guess I implicitly assumed that microstate.

item.title: I toured Unitree's factory. I'm more bullish on the West
item.description:

item.title: Sodium-ion batteries approach cost parity with LFP
item.description:
📝 Markets & Policy See all Sodium-ion batteries approach cost parity with LFP, with 70 GWh covered by supply agreements Sodium-ion batteries are approaching cell-level cost parity with LFP technology, with supply agreements exceeding 70 GWh worldwide. Higher upfront costs, lower total cost of ownership Sodium-ion batteries currently have higher upfront costs than LFP batteries. However, Wood Mackenzie estimates that sodium-ion batteries could achieve a 21% lower total cost of ownership over a 20-year project lifetime.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pv-magazine.com/2026/11/06/sodium-ion-batteries-approach-cost-parity-with-lfp-with-70-gwh-covered-by-supply-agreements/
